summary: Phase 3 of 8 complete: landed kCore (13 shared tags) and all 15 per-system Finset ModalSchemaTag tag sets, plus the 15 bridge equivalences SchemaUnion sysTags φ ↔ <Sys>Axiom φ (S5 bridges to the pre-existing ModalAxiom), in a new file Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/SchemaBridges.lean (786 lines). Executed sequentially as sub-phases 3.1 (kCore+K/T/D/B), 3.2 (K4/K5/K45/S4), 3.3 (S5/TB/KB5), 3.4 (D4/D5/D45/DB), each committed independently once green. kCore is defined via explicit nested `insert … ∅` rather than the `{a,b,c}` literal sugar (the sugar's trailing element is a Singleton, not insert-into-∅, so the Phase-2 elimination API doesn't fire on it -- caught on the first build attempt and fixed). Every tag set was cross-checked against its target inductive's actual constructors (extracted via awk from Instances/*.lean and DerivationTree.lean, not assumed from the plan's prose) before being finalized -- zero deviation from the plan's §1.3 table. Forward direction of each bridge: simp-unfolds SchemaUnion sysTags φ via the elimination API (SchemaUnion.insert_iff/empty_iff) into the named tag disjunction, then `rcases` + `all_goals first | exact <Sys>Axiom.<ctor> _ … | …` closes each resulting goal. Backward direction: direct SchemaUnion witness `⟨.tag, by decide, …, rfl⟩`, no simp needed. Two proof-mechanics bugs were caught and fixed during implementation (both on 2-/3-differentiator systems): a `rcases` slot-count miscount that silently dropped orI2 mid-pattern on the first K45/S4 attempt (3.2) and recurred once more on the first S5 attempt (3.3); both root-caused by re-deriving the exact differentiator-count+13 slot arithmetic, after which every subsequent same-shape system (TB/KB5/D4/D5/DB, D45) built green on the first attempt. Zero sorry, zero new axiom across all 15 bridges. Scoped `lake build` green after every sub-phase; full `lake lint`, `lake exe checkInitImports`, and `lake exe lint-style` all green after the final sub-phase. No instance file, SchemaUnion.lean, or DerivationTree.lean was modified -- fully additive, as scoped. The deliberately-omitted KB5 → S5 subsumption edge was grep-confirmed absent (subsumption is Phase 5's scope). Stopping here per single-phase dispatch scope; Phases 4-8 not started.
